ConnectionStrings.//Default: Documented here, never set here. In production App Service supplies it as a connection string named 'Default' of type 'SQLAzure', which surfaces as SQLAZURECONNSTR_Default and maps back to ConnectionStrings:Default. Locally, appsettings.Development.json points at the Docker container.

AdminSeed.//AdminSeed: Documented here, never set here. In production these come from App Service app settings AdminSeed__Email and AdminSeed__Password (double underscore is the platform's nesting separator), per infrastructure.md's secrets pattern. Locally, appsettings.Development.json supplies development-only values. If Password is empty the seeder logs an error and skips rather than failing startup - so an unseeded production app is a log line, not an outage.
